Close-up photo of the rear sticker showing serial number and storage capacity.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Xbox One S console with one controller from the photos, but none of the seller's functional or provenance claims (storage size, working ports, no overheating, original pad, UK receipt) are shown, so it must be priced at the worst-case assumption of an unverified, base-spec, used Xbox One S.
